policy.promotion_rule: Promotion is optional for source approval, but any assigned promotion technique must produce credible official promotion evidence.
selection_principles: Prefer official structured data over generic text extraction when both are available.
Use discovery and extraction as separate tracks when the strongest techniques differ.
Prefer canonical product identity, price completeness, repeatability, provenance, and catalog coverage over raw record count.
Use an approved edge execution environment only when ordinary cloud/datacenter execution cannot access the same public official surface.
Do not bypass authentication, CAPTCHA, anti-bot challenges, or access controls.

product_price.label: Lotus O2O Product API
product_price.evidence: Official /product/v4/products representation with SKU, regular/final/member price, stock and canonical product URL.

promotion.label: My Lotus's Official Promotion Surface
promotion.evidence: Official promotion listing cards and embedded structured promotion data.

discovery.label: Lotus O2O Structured Catalog Discovery
discovery.evidence: Official category/API pagination and structured URLs provide catalog expansion.

product_price.label: Big C Sitemap Product Detail Catalog

validated_sources.notes: Cloud-hosted public runners were blocked while the same public official site was reachable from an approved normal-network Edge Runner. No access-control bypass is used.

patterns.name: Official Structured Product API
when: Official public API or embedded structured catalog data is discoverable
Product identity and price fields are explicit

patterns.name: Sitemap to Canonical Product Detail
when: Sitemap exposes many canonical product URLs
Product detail pages expose focal SKU and price

patterns.name: Rendered or SSR Product Cards
when: Catalog/search surface renders reliable product cards
Cards expose identity and price without unsafe interaction

patterns.name: Robots / Sitemap Discovery
when: Official robots.txt or sitemap exposes catalog URLs

patterns.name: Reported-Total Catalog Discovery
when: Official catalog surface reports total products/pages

patterns.name: Network / GraphQL Catalog Discovery
when: Public rendered commerce surface reveals an official first-party catalog endpoint
Endpoint can be observed without authentication or challenge bypass
constraints: Discovery evidence does not automatically make the endpoint the best extraction technique

patterns.name: Official Campaign / Promotion Surface
when: Official campaign, catalogue or promotion listing exists
strengths: Best semantic source for promotion title, mechanic, validity and campaign provenance

patterns.name: Split-Track Acquisition
when: No single technique is best for product_price, discovery and promotion
strengths: Avoids forcing one crawler to do incompatible jobs
Lets each track use its strongest evidence source

patterns.name: Approved Edge Execution
when: Public official site works from a normal operating network but blocks cloud/datacenter runners
No authentication, CAPTCHA or anti-bot bypass is required
strengths: Separates live acquisition from deterministic cloud CI

selection_waterfall: Discover all credible official surfaces first.
For product_price prefer SM-P01, then SM-P02, then SM-P03 when quality gates pass.
For discovery prefer SM-P04 or SM-P05; use SM-P06 when modern frontend network structure provides better catalog coverage.
For promotion prefer SM-P07 and do not infer promotions from generic marketing text when an official campaign surface exists.
Use SM-P08 whenever track winners differ.
Use SM-P09 only after cloud access failure is evidenced and normal-network public access is verified.
Deep Audit each selected profile before approval; technique-profile changes invalidate prior approval.
